contract_resolution.successor_contract_effect: V64_E2_SINGLE_SOURCE_SUCCESSOR_CONTRACT_V1 supersedes incompatible V63 single-source clauses and requires the chosen accessibility source bytes/terms to be verified.
contract_resolution.forbidden_upgrade: Do not describe as externally accessibility-supported, independently replicated, or multi-source supported.

s28_liftover_distance.anchor_identity_preserved: C3 remains an exact per-anchor identity gate.
s28_liftover_distance.audit_interpretation: The source 10 kb–1 Mb span is an hg19 source-property. The frozen successor did not impose a post-liftover distance-window filter, so trimming the four >1 Mb hg38 edges now would be post-hoc retuning. Both source and hg38 distances must remain carried into downstream analyses.
s28_liftover_distance.downstream_requirement: Any distance-dependent NIH-CARD or other validation analysis must predeclare whether it uses source hg19 distance, harmonized hg38 distance, or both as a sensitivity analysis before correspondence outcomes are inspected.

accessibility_scope.implication: E2 is internally accessibility-restricted within the Nott study, not externally accessibility-restricted.
